body:
Fountains: corner margin is now a real per-match PRNG output instead of a fixed literal. Shops: fundamental redesign -- 6 neutral, procedurally placed, catalog-split shops replace the old 2-team-shops-sell-everything design; build templates removed per founder direction. New PACKET_ARENA_SNAPSHOT_LAYOUT wire message for apps/arena_bot (also fixed its stale hand-copied position literals). bash scripts/build.sh + build_arena.sh + test_arena.sh all clean (3013 PASS, 0 FAIL). Commits: ECOWAR 7a294b2, aa4c0c0.

⚓ ☃
title: Fountains proceduralized + shops redesigned to 6 neutral catalog-split stores (S376)
